text: One day, a group of travellers came to buy grain. Yusuf looked at them... and knew them instantly. His brothers.
They had no idea who he was.
He gave them their supplies and said: "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. If you do not bring him, there will be no measure for you from me."
At home, Hazrat Yaqub did not want to let his younger son go. "Should I entrust you with him, as I entrusted you with his brother before?"
But they needed food, and he let him go.
When they arrived, Yusuf took his brother aside and told him quietly: "I am your brother. So do not despair over what they used to do."
Then he put the king's golden measuring cup into his brother's bag.
As the caravan set off, a voice called out: "O caravan, indeed you are thieves!"
The bags were searched, one by one. And the cup came out... from the bag of the youngest brother, Binyamin.
The brothers said: "If he steals, a brother of his has stolen before."
They were lying about Yusuf, to Yusuf's face. He kept it within himself, and said nothing.
They begged him: our father is an old man. Take one of us instead.
And they went home... to tell their father he had lost another son.
